notes: three co-transmitters joined by «و» and closed by «جميعا عن» form one level, so one group
«- قال ابن المثنى حدثنا محمد بن جعفر -» is an editor gloss and is left out

«ذكوان، مولى عائشة» is written with his mawla description as the text gives it; the last link is Aisha, the Companion whose words are the saying (the first «عائشة» is in the description, the second is the link)
